sourceSentences: [0] Her W is blatantly just kind of overpowered. It's a damaging spell with a massive shield and that shield allows you to not really trade back onto her while she gets a massive amount of damage onto you.
[0] There is the way number one where she lands her Q first and then she jumps onto you and if she does that, then her jump gets her her cool down refunded, right?
[0] So, her Q is kind of the key to getting these good quality trades because her E cool down is insanely long

[1] you need to either use WQ or use q e um and then keep either the W or the E up so the enemies cannot just jump on top of your face

[1] when not to use e whenever you're playing up against Champs that are able to G close on top of you get close to you um like the echo for example with his e or with a Kiana with her e you cannot really use your e offensively
[2] Syndra is a pretty annoying matchup because every time you try to start her she will kick you out with her E, but it is best to trade when she has the cooldown.
[2] Plus she can just shove you away with E if you get too close, and your W shield isnt strong enough to negate any damage from her Ult.
[3] She has solid gap-closing once she hits you with moonlight, and you need to be mindful of her positioning and your own in this fight.
[3] Go for poke and trades when her W is on cooldown, otherwise she will negate a lot of your poke.
[3] Play safe and try your best to not get hit by her Q as she will most likely dash to you.
